Ichijou"You want to be a relaxed audience? Go to the next world for that. In this one, I don't allow it."
童心"Well, well. The other Arata..."
Ichijou"Ichijou Ayane. Given name Ichijou, family name Ayane. Remember it."
童心"That is your real name?"
Ichijou"Yes. But what does it matter which? Whichever it is, you die."
童心"Kuk-kuk-kuk..."
Ichijou"............"
童心"You did not come this far looking for a place to run, it seems, no?"
Ichijou"Obviously I came chasing."
童心"Me, you mean..."
Ichijou"Your head made a good landmark. Shines nicely even in the dark."
童心"Fa-ha-ha! Naturally, naturally! I polish it regularly, with great care."
Ichijou"After I cut it off, I will tie it to the top of this castle. It will do very well as a lamp, in place of the electric ones."
童心"Huh-huu... Nothing halfhearted about this desire to kill, is there?"
童心"Can you really not forgive this Doushin?"
Ichijou"I will not."
童心"You will strike me down?"
Ichijou"I will."
童心"You will tear this body apart?"
Ichijou"Tear it, crush it, grind it to powder. Drag out your guts and make you eat them. Gouge out your eyes and testiclesballs and feed them to the crows."
Ichijou"While you are still alive."
童心"What fine entertainment. But for what reason, I wonder...?"
Ichijou"Reason?"
童心"............"
Ichijou"Fudaraku has everything. Money, treasure, weapons, the latest machines..."
Ichijou"And yet, apparently, not one single mirror."
童心"Guh."
Ichijou"..."
童心"Kuh, fuh-fuh-fuh-fuh...!"
Ichijou"—Hyah!"

en.html:
童心"How embarrassing, how embarrassing! True, this monk Yusa does not keep a mirror installed in his heart."
童心"Every step I take, must I turn round and inspect the last one? Life is far too enjoyable. Where is the time?"
Ichijou"............ Why did you do that?"
童心"Hm?"
Ichijou"What you did to the Okabe princess."
童心"Ah, that."
童心"I wanted to."
Ichijou"............ Then what was the Noh before it?"
Ichijou"That Yorimasa... Was all of it only to bait・・・・・ the princess?"
童心"No. That too was something I wanted to do. Lord Yoritsuna and I were friends for many years, beyond the division of ally and enemy. To think of his violent death—something rises in my heart!"
童心"I let that feeling lead me and danced. How did you find it?"
Ichijou"............ Then—"
Ichijou"Why did you make a Noh mask from the bones of that friend of many years?"
童心"I wanted to. I thought it would be interesting・・・・・・・."
Ichijou"............"
童心"Kuk-kuk-kuk..."
Ichijou"You... do everything you want to do?"
童心"Haan!"
Ichijou"You think that is allowed?"
童心"Mana kaun karega? Who is going to forbid me?"
Ichijou"..."
童心"The courts, perhaps? Afraid not. Human law is so arranged that greater political powerstrength puts a man beyond its punishments."
童心"Then gods and Buddhas? Does the law of heaven refuse me? But this monk Doushin has met no accident, caught no disease, passed through forests of swords and rains of bullets, and here he is, still living, you see..."
童心"Now, then. Who refuses me permission?"
Ichijou"I do."
童心"...Ohh."
Ichijou"Laws, gods, Buddhas—I don't give a damn what they say. I do not forgive you."
童心"...Ichijou, was it?"
童心"Whose orders are you acting on?"
Ichijou"Nobody gave me any order."
童心"And what comes of taking my head? Money? Some position?"
Ichijou"Idiot. Who would pay even one paisa for the life of garbage like you?"
童心"Then all this really is... only that anger・・・・?"
童心"You will kill me from righteous outrage alone?"
Ichijou"Yes. That is all・・・・・・."
Ichijou"I kill you because I cannot forgive you. I, and Masamune."

童心 「心のざわめきの赴くまま、舞ってみた。 　如何であったかな？」
一条 「…………。 　なら」

童心 「やりたかったんでの。 　おもしろかろう・・・・・・・と思うて」
一条 「…………」
童心 「くっくっく……」
一条 「てめぇは…… 　やりたいことは、何でもやるのか」
童心 「うむ！」
一条 「許されると思ってんのか？」
童心 「誰が許さぬ？」
一条 「……」
童心 「司法かな？ 　いや、残念。人の法律は権力ちからで優る相手を 罰せられぬように出来ておる」
童心 「では神仏かな？　天の法が許さぬか？ 　いや、しかし……この童心坊めは事故にも 遭わず病にも罹らず、剣林弾雨も潜り抜け、 こうして生き続けておるがなァ……」
童心 「さぁて。 　誰がわしを許さぬ？」
一条 「あたしだ」
童心 「……ほゥ」
一条 「法律や神仏がどうだろうと知るか。 　あたしが、おまえを許さない」
童心 「……一条、と申したな」
童心 「おぬし、誰の命を受けて動いておる？」
一条 「命令なんか、誰からも受けてねえ」
童心 「わしの首を獲ると、どうなるのかの。 　金になるか？　それとも、地位でも貰える かな」
一条 「馬鹿が。 　てめぇみたいなクズの命に、びた一文でも 払おうなんて奴がいるかよ」
童心 「ではおぬしは、本当に…… 　その怒り・・・・だけなのか」
童心 「義憤一つでわしを殺そうてか」
一条 「そうだよ。 　それだけだよ・・・・・・」
一条 「てめぇが許せねぇから殺す。 　このあたしと――正宗が」

Ichijou"There is no other reasonnone. I don't need one."
童心"..."
童心"Fuh—"
Ichijou"..."
童心"KUAH-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA-HA!! I see! I see! I see・・・!!"
童心"One pure and innocent young woman—and Masamune, Gorou Nyuudou Masamune of Soushuu!?"
童心"One day, I thought. One day somebody exactly like you would come!"
Ichijou"What?"
童心"The heart of basarabasara is not merely to make an eccentric displayshow off. Jo dil chahe—whatever the heart demands, do it! Unhesitatingwithout hesitation! Shamelesswithout shame! Thoughtlesswithout thought!"
童心"Only by carrying one desire through to the end is it basara! And can such a way of living be permitted among human beings!?"
童心"No! It must not be permitted! If it were permitted・・・・・, what would be left to enjoy?"
童心"Deny me! Insignificant masses, you nobodies, gather your will and strength and block my road!"
童心"Send against me a hero・・ of the righteous path!!"
Ichijou"————"
童心"What road is a road without hardship? What basara is it that never fights the righteous path?"
童心"Holy armorHoly armor that breaks evil—Gorou Masamune! I have been waiting for you to come!"
Ichijou"...So you're prepared for it?"
童心"Were you listening at all? Prepared-shrepared! I have no such intention."
童心"I will trample you flat, and with that complete my life."
童心"A man who regarded nothing, lived on his own greed, received no punishment, and ended his life full and satisfied—the most outrageous・・・・ man in the whole world, that is what I will be!"
Ichijou"I won't let you!! Masamune!!"
正宗《Aye!!》

童心"I will trample you flat, and with that complete my life."

童心"A man who regarded nothing, lived on his own greed, received no punishment, and ended his life full and satisfied—the most outrageous・・・・ man in the whole world, that is what I will be!"

Ichijou"I won't let you!! Masamune!!"

正宗《Aye!!》
